maker: Hangzhou Fengtan Robot Co., Ltd. (Fulltime Robotics)
name: Fengtan 3.2 m putty scraping and sanding robot
summary: Indoor robot that scrapes and sands putty and filler on walls and ceilings in flats up to 3.2 m, using force-controlled tools and automatic path planning. Launched by Fengtan of Hangzhou in July 2024.
